historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use to construct a new building containing two market-rate dwelling units on a vacant lot.
The property was a vacant lot.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the project to change the use of the site from vacant to two market-rate units, as proposed.
